description: From the summit, the square red-brick Himmelbjerg tower stands closed above the dark water of Julsø, with forested ridges beyond. The night is overcast, about 11.6°C, and the hill is empty. Late-September heath is dull, not a purple bloom. The tower's own hours in this part of September end in the afternoon, so the viewing gallery is dark.
